news.title: Vision Corporation Limited Announces Executive Changes, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Vision Corporation Limited's Board of Directors at the meeting held on January 9, 2026 approved the resignation of Mrs. KaalindiMisra from the post of Chairperson of the Company. Date of Cessation: January 9, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Aashutosh Mishra as the Chairperson of the Company. Date of appointment: January 9, 2026. Mr. Aashutosh Mishra is associated with the Company, since 2008 and was appointed as the Executive Director of the Company since 2023. He has also been appointed as the CFO of the Company since May, 2024. He has contributed remarkably in progress and success of the Company.
